name: freewash
description: Free-roam WebGL game set in Washington Square Park, rendered as pixel art - walk or skate around the marble arch, fountain and tree-lined paths. Golden-hour lighting and true-scale detail, squeezed through a low-res buffer, nearest-neighbour upscale and a dithered palette. Renders entirely in the browser via three.js/WebGL.

endpoints.play: Serve the game and open it in the browser
endpoints.serve: Start the static WebGL game server
